description: Lists the setup guides this server can show: document key, title and a one-line summary for each. Call this first, then fetch a document with docs_get. To set JanuaPort up, first ask whether it already runs as a container: if not, start with `installation` (on Mac or Windows, tell the user first that Docker Desktop is for trying it out and a Linux server is recommended for operation); if it does, start with `inbetriebnahme`. Every answer names the JanuaPort release the guides belong to. Reads only; changes nothing.
name: docs_list
